title: Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle

result.label: Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
result.statement: Proves that the billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to π is weakly mixing for normalized area times uniform direction. This strengthens ergodicity on the entire irrational-angle class, with no genericity or Diophantine restrictions.
